scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from an exact five-coefficient convolution and complete factorization of all three log-concavity defects. The bundled exact-rational script is supplementary regression checking only and is not used to infer the all-parameter statement.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence is proved for a two-trial binomial count and jumps supported on three consecutive values.
No sufficiency claim is made for three or more binomial trials or for jumps whose maximum value is at least three.
Originality retains residual risk from older convolution-sequence literature under different terminology.
title: Minimal jump support for failure of the two-trial compound-binomial log-concavity criterion
